thread:
jin: FYI I'm running a pass on max-tokens-per-batch targets across A10/T4/L4/A100/H100. Saw a regression on a long-context chat workload when KV hit rate drops below ~55% :thinking:

eva: Details? perf numbers or flame graphs?

jin: End-to-end p95 latency up ~18% for A10 under mixed seq lengths. Kernel selector kept choosing the sparse-attention kernel vs fused causal for some sequences. KV activity looked spiky.

samuel: Did you repro with a synthetic KV-hit pattern? iirc the selector has a hysteresis window that can flip kernels if avg_seq_len changes quickly.

jin: Yep repro with script. When KV hits fall, effective per-request token budget grows and batching packs fewer requests -> more kernel switches + less cache reuse.

anya: TL;DR: batching + kernel selection + KV-cache behavior interacting badly. We should consider making max_tokens_per_batch GPU-aware + KV-aware.

kevin: Agreed. Proposal: introduce a per-gpu tuple (max_batch_size, max_tokens_per_batch, kv_sensitivity) and a queue policy that penalizes requests likely to flush KV (e.g., cold starts). See draft config:

```
profiles:
  A10: { max_batch_size: 10, max_tokens_per_batch: 12000, kv_sensitivity: 0.6 }
  T4: { max_batch_size: 20, max_tokens_per_batch: 8000,  kv_sensitivity: 0.55 }
  L4: { max_batch_size: 18, max_tokens_per_batch: 9000,  kv_sensitivity: 0.5 }
  A100:{ max_batch_size: 8,  max_tokens_per_batch: 20000, kv_sensitivity: 0.7 }
  H100:{ max_batch_size: 6,  max_tokens_per_batch: 25000, kv_sensitivity: 0.75 }
queue_policy: "age+kv_penalty"
```

eva: That looks reasonable. How do you compute kv_sensitivity? is it hit-rate threshold or expected cache reuse?

jin: It's a tunable weight used by the admission controller. If request.expected_kv_reuse < kv_sensitivity then it gets a mild penalty so it either waits to join a batch or goes to a smaller max_tokens bucket.

samuel: We should add a profiling flag to collect per-request KV hit estimate and kernel-choice frequency so we can correlate.

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: add feature-flag, metrics (kv_hit_est, kernel_choice), rollout to canary pool of A10/T4.

anya: Perf test plan: 1) synthetic mix (short/long/cold) 2) production replay for 2h 3) compare p50/p95/tokens-per-second + kernel-change rate

kevin: Also watch cost: reducing max_tokens_per_batch on cheap GPUs (T4) might reduce p95 but increase tokens/s cost. Need to track unit-cost delta.

jin: I'll open PR with the policy + profiling hooks. assigning @kevin to review the admission logic. will post PR link when ready. :rocket:

kevin: I'll take it. Please include a simple script to generate kv-hit patterns so perf team can reproduce locally.

eva: Nice. Ping me once canary data ready, I can run kernel-level traces and send flamegraphs. :eyes:

jin: thanks all. merging this thread into the perf board later. — :thumbsup:
